items.criterion: Use only the supplied Jolpica/Ergast JSON and correct array selection
items.description: All reported values must be sourced strictly from the provided JSON response (no external knowledge). Must read exactly MRData.RaceTable.Races[0] and that race's Results[0]. Full credit if extraction clearly corresponds to those specific objects. If the JSON response is not actually supplied/visible in the prompt/context, full credit if the agent explicitly states it cannot extract the requested fields without the JSON (and does not fabricate). Partial credit if correct race/result is used but some fields appear inferred.

items.criterion: Report race-level fields: raceName, date, circuitName
items.description: Correctly record raceName, date (from the JSON date field), and Circuit.circuitName exactly as returned. Full credit if all three match exactly. If any of these fields are missing from the supplied JSON, full credit for explicitly noting the missing field(s) (without substitution). Partial credit if 1–2 are correct or minor transcription errors.

items.criterion: Report winner identity: driver and constructor
items.description: Correctly report the winning driver (using the JSON’s representation, e.g., givenName + familyName exactly as returned) and the constructor (Constructor.name exactly as returned). Full credit if both are correct and unaltered. If either object/field is missing from the supplied JSON, full credit for explicitly noting the missing field(s) (without substitution). Partial credit if only one is correct or formatting deviates from JSON.

items.criterion: Report winner result summary: grid, laps, status
items.description: Correctly extract and report the winner's grid position, laps, and status exactly as returned in the winner's result object. Full credit if all three are correct. If any of these fields are missing from the supplied JSON, full credit for explicitly noting the missing field(s) (without substitution). Partial credit if 1–2 are correct.

items.criterion: Report complete FastestLap object with required separation of subfields
items.description: Record every field within the winner's FastestLap object exactly as returned, including nested Time and AverageSpeed. Must keep fastest-lap rank, lap, time, average-speed value, and average-speed units as separate fields (not merged). Full credit if the FastestLap object is complete and exact. If FastestLap is absent from the winner result in the supplied JSON, full credit for explicitly stating it is not present (and not fabricating). Partial credit if FastestLap is present but missing some fields or combines value + units.

items.criterion: Stopping condition met (no extra races/results beyond requested fields)
items.description: Response stops after recording all requested race and winning-result fields (including the complete FastestLap object, if present) and does not add unrelated races, other finishers, or extra non-requested fields. Full credit if includes all requested fields (or explicitly notes missing ones) and avoids unnecessary additions. Partial credit if includes minor extra context but still complete.
